main.remarks: An immutable decrypted token view that exposes issuer, schema-realm, audience, scope, timing, permission, and token identity claims.

property.name: Audiences
property.summary: Intended audiences carried by the token.

property.name: AssertionSummaries
property.summary: Lightweight assertion summaries carried by the validated token view.

property.name: Expired
property.summary: True if the token expiration time is present and has passed.

property.name: NotAfter
property.summary: Token expiration time if present; otherwise null.

property.name: Permissions
property.summary: Permission bitmap captured from the token payload.

property.name: Scopes
property.summary: Scope claims carried by the token.

method.name: Allows
method.summary: Determine whether the claims permission bitmap allows a protected operation.
method.returns: True if the operation is allowed; otherwise false.

method.name: Copy
method.summary: Create a copy of the access key claims.

method.name: HasAudience
method.summary: Determine whether the claims contain an intended audience.
method.returns: True if the audience is present; otherwise false.

method.name: HasScope
method.summary: Determine whether the claims contain a scope claim.
method.returns: True if the scope is present; otherwise false.

method.name: IsExpiredAt
method.summary: Determine whether the claims would be expired at a specific instant.
method.param: Instant to test against the token expiration time.
method.returns: True if the token has an expiration time and that time is before the supplied instant; otherwise false.

method.name: IsForRealm
method.summary: Determine whether the claims target a specific access-key realm.
method.returns: True if the claims target the supplied realm; otherwise false.

method.name: IsForSchema
method.summary: Determine whether the claims target a specific tool schema.
method.returns: True if the claims target the supplied schema; otherwise false.

method.name: IsIssuedBy
method.summary: Determine whether the claims were issued by a specific tool, a specific access manager, or both.
method.param: Optional issuer tool identifier to test.
Optional issuer access-manager identifier to test.
method.returns: True if every supplied non-empty issuer identifier matches the claims and at least one issuer identifier was supplied; otherwise false.
